parameter_semantics: source_object selects the currently observed manipulated source pose used as the per-chunk Cartesian frame; destination_object selects the observed bowl pose used in source-to-destination conditioning. Both are semantic observation selectors, not actuator commands.
output_semantics: Each slot is an absolute Cartesian TCP target expressed in the source-container pose frozen at chunk construction: source-frame position xyz in metres, source-frame orientation as the first two rotation-matrix columns (6D), and one native gripper scalar. The decoder projects 6D to SO(3), left-composes the frozen chunk-start source pose to obtain a world TCP target, and calls panda_kinematics.solve_ik from freshly measured joints. Slots represent t-1 through t+14; execution uses slots 1 through 8. Gripper values retain the native >=0 open, <0 close rule.

conversion_check.description: Compare FK of IK output to the demonstrated commanded world TCP target in metres/radians and compare the unchanged gripper scalar. The only projection is robust Gram-Schmidt of the learned 6D rotation; exact encoded targets are already valid rotations.

cut_relation: Uses every assigned [0,360) occurrence without trimming and preserves the complete action-supervised [180,360) overlap with controlled_pour_and_right. The implementation refines the approved source-frame invocation contract at each 8-step replan.
